mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates improving labor market conditions, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% occurs in periods where SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate synchronized labor market and manufacturing recovery, reducing recession risk and increasing equity demand for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decline > 0.1pp and INDPRO decline > 0.5 points in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint decline condition occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary conditions (GDPC1 decline for two consecutive quarters), housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 450 thousand units signals sector recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 450 in recessionary periods (GDPC1 decline) but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate increased consumer confidence and construction activity, correlating with stronger economic growth and positive equity market sentiment for S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by at least 10 thousand units over prior month but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 100 thousand jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions, increasing household income and consumer spending for positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 100k occurs but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 points after a decline below 90 indicates manufacturing recovery, reducing recession risk and increasing equity demand for positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rebound > 95 occurs but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is ≤0.5% and CPIAUCSL change < 0.5% per month, low interest rates and stable inflation create favorable equity investment conditions for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% and CPIAUCSL change < 0.5% per month
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rate environment
failure_condition: The joint condition occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.
